enriched_activities.desc: Lies on bed. Closes eyes. Pulls blanket over body. Turns to left side. Adjusts pillow. Remains asleep. Turns to right side. Moves arm under pillow. Continues sleeping.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up, taking daily medication, and showering
enriched_activities.desc: Wakes up. Sits up. Stands up. Walks to bathroom. Turns on bathroom light. Turns on tap. Washes face. Picks up toothbrush. Applies toothpaste. Brushes teeth. Rinses mouth. Turns off tap. Takes medication bottle. Opens cap. Takes pill. Swallows with water. Turns on shower. Adjusts temperature. Steps into shower. Washes body. Rinses. Turns off shower. Steps out. Dries with towel.

Puts on shoes. Opens front door. Steps outside. Closes door. Walks along sidewalk. Turns left at corner. Continues walking. Passes houses. Turns right. Walks around block. Returns to house. Opens door. Enters. Closes door. Removes shoes.

Walks to kitchen. Greets Member 1. Opens refrigerator. Takes out milk. Takes out cereal box. Picks up bowl. Pours cereal. Pours milk. Picks up spoon. Sits at table. Eats cereal. Drinks milk. Talks with Member 1. Finishes eating. Picks up bowl and spoon. Walks to sink. Rinses bowl. Places in dishwasher. Wipes hands.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting ready and packing bag for university
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bedroom. Opens wardrobe. Selects clothes. Removes shirt. Puts on shirt. Puts on pants. Puts on socks. Puts on shoes. Opens backpack. Places notebook in backpack. Places laptop in backpack. Places pen case in backpack. Zips backpack. Checks phone. Picks up keys. Puts keys in pocket.
Sits at desk. Turns on desk lamp. Opens notebook. Reads notes. Highlights key points. Closes notebook. Turns off desk lamp. Stands up. Picks up backpack.
Walks to bus stop. Waits for bus. Boards bus. Taps transit card. Finds seat. Sits down. Looks out window. Checks phone. Bus arrives at campus. Stands up. Exits bus. Walks to campus building.

Enters classroom. Sits at desk. Takes out notebook. Takes out pen. Listens to lecture. Writes notes. Raises hand to ask question. Takes out laptop. Opens laptop. Types notes. Checks phone during break. Stands up. Stretches. Walks to library. Finds study spot. Sits down. Opens textbook. Reads chapter. Highlights text. Writes summary.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating lunch on campus with Member 1, Member 4, and Member 5
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to cafeteria. Joins Member 1, Member 4, Member 5 at table. Sits down. Opens lunch box. Takes out sandwich. Takes bite. Chews. Swallows. Talks with Member 1. Drinks water. Finishes sandwich. Picks up tray. Walks to bin. Scraps leftovers. Places tray on rack. Returns to table. Talks more.

Enters classroom. Sits down. Takes out notebook. Opens notebook. Writes notes. Listens to professor. Asks question. Takes out calculator. Solves problem. Checks answer. Closes notebook. Puts materials in backpack. Stands up. Walks to next class.
Walks to train station. Boards train. Finds seat. Sits down. Reads textbook. Checks phone. Train arrives. Exits train. Walks to tutoring center. Enters building. Greets receptionist.

Enters tutoring room. Greets student. Sits at table. Opens textbook. Explains concept. Writes on whiteboard. Answers student questions. Assigns practice problems. Checks student work. Provides feedback. Packs up materials. Says goodbye. Walks out.
Walks to bus stop. Waits for bus. Boards bus. Taps card. Sits down. Checks phone. Bus arrives at stop. Exits bus. Walks home. Opens front door. Enters house.

Walks to kitchen. Opens cabinet. Takes out cat food can. Opens can. Picks up cat bowl. Empties old food. Washes bowl. Scoops food into bowl. Places bowl on floor. Cat approaches. Watches cat eat. Picks up water bowl. Refills with water. Places bowl down. Wipes counter. Throws away empty can.

Walks to living room. Sits on sofa with Member 4 and Member 5. Opens laptop. Logs into bank account. Checks rent amount. Transfers money to landlord. Opens calendar. Schedules chores. Assigns tasks to members. Points to chore chart. Writes down assignments. Sends message to Member 4 about chores. Closes laptop. Stands up.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking and eating dinner with Member 1 and Member 2
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to kitchen. Washes hands. Opens refrigerator. Takes out vegetables. Places on cutting board. Picks up knife. Chops vegetables. Turns on stove. Places pan on stove. Adds oil. Adds vegetables. Stirs with spatula. Adds seasoning. Turns off stove. Picks up plates. Serves food. Sits at table with Member 1 and Member 2. Eats dinner. Talks.
Walks to bedroom. Sits at desk. Turns on desk lamp. Opens laptop. Opens textbook. Reads chapter. Takes notes. Solves problems. Checks solutions. Closes laptop. Turns off desk lamp.

enriched_activities.activity: Personal hygiene and preparing for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bathroom. Turns on light. Turns on tap. Washes face. Picks up toothbrush. Applies toothpaste. Brushes teeth. Rinses mouth. Turns off tap. Dries face. Changes into pajamas. Turns off light. Walks to bedroom.

Sits at desk. Turns on desk lamp. Opens laptop. Reviews lecture slides. Reads textbook. Writes equations. Uses calculator. Checks answers. Highlights notes. Closes laptop. Turns off desk lamp. Stretches. Stands up.
Walks to living room. Sits on sofa. Picks up remote. Turns on TV. Changes channels. Watches show. Laughs. Checks phone. Turns off TV. Stands up. Walks to bedroom.
Walks to bedroom. Turns off light. Lies on bed. Pulls blanket. Closes eyes. Adjusts pillow. Turns to left side. Remains asleep. Turns to right side. Moves arm. Continues sleeping.
